name: WARDED ARMOUR
text: Each turning point, as a strategic gambit, a friendly Legionary's Save becomes 2+ until the Ready step of the next Strategy phase.

name: MALEFIC BLADES
text: Every friendly Legionary carries a malefic blade (Atk 5, Hit 3+, Dmg 3/4) for the battle.

name: TAINTED ROUNDS
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly Legionary performing Shoot selects a bolt pistol or boltgun, that weapon has Rending until the action ends.

name: CHAOS TALISMANS
text: Each turning point, as a strategic gambit, pick a Mark of Chaos: friendly Legionaries of that mark may suffer D3 damage once per activation to turn two attack fails into one normal success.
